title_en: Near the new boulevard, on the street Jordan Misja, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with super floor plan!
description_en: Near New Boulevard, Jordan Misja Street, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale with Super Floor Plan! The apartment has a total area of ​​99.25 m2, net 85.72 m2 and is located on the 2nd residential floor of a building under construction, which is expected to be completed in about 2 years. The apartment is organized by the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen area, a matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet, a bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet with a window. The orientation of the apartment is south-west.
